subtitle: Lesson 2 · Securing the Pipeline Itself

code:
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write   # needed for OIDC federation

# anything not listed here is denied,
# not just unused
caption: Declare the minimum scope explicitly — don't rely on the broad default.

code:
- uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
  with:
    role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/gh-actions-deploy
    aws-region: us-east-1

# no static AWS key stored anywhere —
# the role's trust policy restricts which repo/branch can assume it
caption: OIDC federation: a fresh, minutes-lived session instead of a standing secret.

steps.label: A static key works from anywhere, indefinitely
steps.sub: until someone remembers to rotate it

steps.label: An OIDC session is scoped to one workflow run
steps.sub: tied to "this repo, this branch, this event"

steps.label: It expires in minutes
steps.sub: a leaked log can't be replayed later from elsewhere
